mechanism: Ginseng may potentiate dopaminergic effects and increase CNS stimulation when combined with pramipexole, a dopamine agonist, potentially exacerbating adverse effects such as dyskinesia or psychomotor complications.
action: Monitor patients for increased dopaminergic side effects including dyskinesia, hallucinations, or psychomotor disturbances; consider dose adjustment or discontinuation of ginseng if symptoms emerge.
